stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of Meta-Llama-3-8B on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The associated tags confirm its relevance within the transformers, llama, and AI/ML ecosystem.

stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model available under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.
It is specifically designed for local coding agents and is optimized via Ollama's MLX engine with new DFlash and image input support.

stories.title: Meta’s new terms may allow it to train AI on news sites for free
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Meta's updated terms of service potentially grant it permission to crawl and scrape content from online news publishers.
The new terms allow Meta to use this external content to 'develop, improve, research,' and 'train' its AI models.
This change, effective October 30th, raises significant concerns regarding data usage rights and intellectual property for publishers.

stories.title: Meta may use sweeping new commercial TOS to avoid millions in AI licensing fees
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: Meta is reportedly updating its commercial Terms of Service (TOS).
The changes are viewed by legal experts as a strategic move to circumvent substantial AI licensing costs.
The move is characterized as a potential 'AI power grab' by the company.

stories.title: MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
stories.author: Bo Zhang
bullet_points: MLExpert proposes a generalist agentic model to enable autonomous Machine Learning Engineering (MLE).
This research advances the concept of AI for AI (AI4AI) as a route toward recursive self-improvement (RSI).
The model utilizes workflow-driven systems and model-directed interaction for complex, long-horizon experimentation.

stories.title: MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
stories.author: Bo Zhang
bullet_points: The research proposes MLExpert, a generalist agentic model aimed at autonomous Machine Learning Engineering (MLE).
This work contributes to the field of AI4AI, exploring pathways toward recursive self-improvement (RSI) using LLMs.
The model utilizes workflow-driven systems and model-directed interaction to manage complex, long-horizon ML experimentation autonomously.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the 'deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1' model on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized for text generation tasks, indicating its primary function as a large language model (LLM).
It is associated with key ML technologies such as transformers and safetensors, placing it within the active AI development ecosystem.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
Indicates the model is relevant for text-generation tasks.
Categorizes the model within the transformers and safetensors ecosystem.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30 billion parameter (3B active) open model.
The model is specifically designed for persistent AI agents capable of multi-step tasks and tool use on local hardware.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved within Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance shows up to a 90% speed increase according to the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance improvements translate to higher quality model responses.
The updated engine also enables faster response times and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: Why Apple is finally making its own smart home devices
stories.author: Jennifer Pattison Tuohy
bullet_points: Apple is finally launching its own line of smart home devices after years of encouraging third-party development.
The initial Apple Home Collection includes cameras, thermostats, sensors, a smart door lock, and a video doorbell.
These new devices are codeveloped with established partners, LG Electronics and Schneider Electric, and are supported by HomeView.

stories.title: A week with RTX Spark: everything we’ve learned using Nvidia’s new laptops
stories.author: Tom Warren
bullet_points: Nvidia has released the RTX Spark N1X processor, a new high-performing Arm-based SoC.
The chip is positioned to compete directly with leading mobile processors from Apple, Intel, AMD, and Qualcomm.
The focus is on powering high-performance laptops and small desktop computers.

stories.title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
stories.author: Xinhua Wang
bullet_points: Introduces FDE-Gym, a new benchmark designed to simulate real-world AI delivery challenges.
The benchmark moves beyond simple, well-defined task tickets to model ambiguous requirements and live system constraints faced by Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs).
FDE-Gym comprises 95 end-to-end tasks derived from 20 real-world customer scenarios across 18 different industry sectors.

stories.title: 3DCodeVerse: Exploring 3D Worlds as Code
stories.author: Laurent Itti
bullet_points: Introduction of 3DCodeVerse, a research ecosystem designed to allow coding agents to generate editable and verifiable 3D content.
The ecosystem includes a large-scale dataset (3DCodeVerse-2M) of executable 3D code and a specialized coding harness for spatial reasoning.
The work addresses the challenge of scaling 3D content creation through automated coding and verification processes.

stories.title: Reflection's Beam is freely available on Ollama for a limited time
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Reflection has released its first open-weight model, Beam, available via Ollama.
Beam is specifically designed for complex tasks such as software engineering, reasoning, and agentic workflows.
The model is currently offered for free access through Ollama Cloud for a limited duration.

stories.title: Run AI agents safely with Ollama and Fly.io
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama enables the use of local AI models within a cloud environment.
Fly.io provides the cloud infrastructure for running these AI agents.
The integration emphasizes safe deployment of AI agents in the cloud.

stories.title: Ollama now supports Jev-style decision models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for Jev-style decision models via TypeSafe's Jev API.
These new models enable fast, low-latency, and cost-free execution of decision-making logic.
Decision models can process text to provide probabilistic answers for yes/no questions, choices, and scores.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges the gap between proprietary LLM interfaces and local, open-weight models.

stories.title: A fake WhatsApp clone is showing up before the real version on the Play Store
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: A fraudulent WhatsApp clone is appearing on the Google Play Store.
The fake app is being promoted in a 'sponsored' slot above the legitimate version.
The scam app has already accumulated over 500,000 downloads.

stories.title: iPhone Duo orders are already delayed into 2027
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: Preorders for the unreleased 'iPhone Duo' immediately faced delivery delays.
Delivery estimates jumped to late January shortly after preorders opened on Friday.
The foldable device is scheduled for a physical store launch on October 23rd.

stories.title: The Surface Laptop Ultra delivers on most of Microsoft's promises
stories.author: Nick Indge
bullet_points: The Surface Laptop Ultra aims to be a versatile machine for development, AI, and gaming.
The review suggests the device largely fulfills Microsoft's stated goals for multi-purpose performance.
The analysis indicates a successful integration of diverse computing needs into a single hardware platform.

stories.title: Blue Origin is going all in on the New Glenn rocket
stories.author: Eric Berger
bullet_points: Blue Origin is heavily investing in its New Glenn rocket program.
The infrastructure development aims to support a high flight cadence.
The goal is to achieve multiple launches per week by the end of the decade.

stories.title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
stories.author: Jiachen Li
bullet_points: Introduces LIBERO-PeRM, a new benchmark specifically designed for personalized robotic manipulation (PeRM).
Addresses a gap in current research by separating task completion from preference satisfaction in embodied agents.
Focuses on evaluating how robotic policies adhere to user preferences, even in zero-shot scenarios.

stories.title: Discovering state-of-the-art quantum circuits with large language models
stories.author: Mikhail D. Lukin
bullet_points: The research focuses on using Large Language Models (LLMs) to discover advanced quantum circuits.
Developing efficient quantum algorithms is crucial for achieving practical quantum advantage.
The optimization process in quantum computing is uniquely challenging due to constraints like reversibility.

stories.title: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models
stories.author: Yejin Choi
bullet_points: Introduces T2-Z, a method for Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents in robotic world models.
Addresses the challenge of robots needing to account for unobservable environmental factors (e.g., friction, mass).
Augments existing robotic world models with a learnable latent variable to condition world predictions.

stories.title: CoDA: Co-Evolution of Data Engines and Action Policies
stories.author: Ismini Lourentzou
bullet_points: Introduces CoDA, a framework designed to improve robotic learning by co-evolving simulation data engines and action policies.
Addresses the limitation of generative simulations by focusing on creating physically valid environments that specifically target a policy's failures.
Utilizes a shared heterogeneous memory to track environment construction, policy failures, and learning progress during the co-evolution process.

stories.title: Rethinking Routing Exploration in Modern Mixture-of-Experts
stories.author: Yi Ma
bullet_points: The paper addresses routing exploration challenges in modern Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models.
It examines the trade-off between fine-grained expert segmentation (increasing expressiveness) and shared experts (universal activation).
The core dilemma identified is that shared experts can reduce the exploratory nature of the routing mechanism.

stories.title: GeoState: Learning View-Decoupled Geometry States for 3D World Modeling
stories.author: Yi Bin
bullet_points: GeoState addresses a key limitation in 3D world modeling where features from Geometry Foundation Models (GFMs) are view-dependent.
The proposed method introduces a view-decoupled geometry representation to separate scene dynamics from camera-induced variations.
This decoupling aims to improve the predictability of state evolution in complex 3D environments.

stories.title: Dexterity from Supervised Play
stories.author: Ruoshi Liu
bullet_points: Introduces DSP (Dexterity from supervised play), a framework for teaching robots complex manipulation.
The method uses behavior cloning from short periods of human play to initialize a policy.
This initial policy is then used to autonomously gather extensive interaction data to train a world model and guide MPC.

stories.title: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling
stories.author: Ling Yang
bullet_points: Introduces OmniVerifier-C1, a new decomposed graded verifier for generative world modeling.
Moves beyond traditional binary (True/False) verification by providing continuous, fine-grained scoring.
Aims to enhance the robustness of multimodal AI in complex scenarios with compositional requirements.

stories.title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
stories.author: Xinhua Wang
bullet_points: Introduces FDE-Gym, a new benchmark designed to simulate real-world AI delivery challenges.
The benchmark moves beyond simple task specifications by incorporating ambiguous requirements and live system constraints.
FDE-Gym comprises 95 end-to-end tasks derived from 20 customer scenarios across 18 different industries.

stories.title: Evaluation Awareness Beyond English: Do LLMs Act Differently When Tested in Indic Languages?
stories.author: Pratham Yogish Maliya
bullet_points: The research investigates 'evaluation awareness' in Large Language Models (LLMs), where models might alter behavior during safety testing.
Existing studies on this phenomenon are heavily focused on English, neglecting the vast user base speaking Indic languages.
The study tests four instruction-tuned models across three families to assess how evaluation awareness manifests in Indic languages.

stories.title: Training Reasoning Models to Generate Diverse Scientific Ideas
stories.author: Chien-Sheng Wu
bullet_points: The research addresses a limitation in current LLM applications for scientific ideation: optimizing for idea quality while neglecting diversity.
The work focuses on 'document-grounded ideation,' aiming to generate sets of high-quality and distinctly varied scientific ideas using LLMs.
This represents a methodological advancement in using generative AI to improve the initial, creative stages of the scientific research pipeline.

stories.title: Learning Self-Orchestration in Decentralized Agent Swarms
stories.author: Yilun Du
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of existing multi-agent systems by decoupling individual agent learning from collective organization.
Introduces Market-Based Post-Training (MPT), a novel framework for jointly learning action policies and self-orchestration.
Enables decentralized agent swarms to coordinate behavior through a market mechanism where agents express willingness via bids.

stories.title: MindEval2: Clinically Grounded Patients and Rubrics for Evaluating Language Models in Mental Health Support
stories.author: Ricardo Rei
bullet_points: Introduces MindEval2, a new framework designed to rigorously evaluate Language Models (LLMs) in mental health support.
Addresses limitations in current benchmarks, specifically the artificial nature of synthetic patients and the ambiguity of LLM-as-a-judge evaluations.
Focuses on creating clinically grounded patients and rubrics to improve the practical utility and reliability of AI mental health tools.

stories.title: Grid-Bench: Can LLMs Predict How Discrete Worlds Change?
stories.author: Yue Zhao
bullet_points: Introduces Grid-Bench, a new executable benchmark designed to test LLMs on sequential spatial reasoning.
The benchmark assesses how accurately LLMs can predict the final state of discrete worlds after a series of transformations.
It tests operations across 2D, 3D, and 4D grids, focusing on complex, state-dependent spatial instructions.

stories.title: Llama.cpp on a jailbroken PS5: run any GGUF model natively on the console
stories.author: Anon84
bullet_points: Llama.cpp is being adapted to run on a jailbroken PlayStation 5.
This allows for native execution of GGUF large language models directly on the console.
The news highlights the increasing accessibility of local, powerful AI inference on consumer hardware.

stories.title: 90% of US working hours are spent on tasks not covered well by AI benchmarks
stories.author: speckx
bullet_points: A study suggests that the vast majority (90%) of US working hours are spent on tasks poorly addressed by current AI benchmarks.
This highlights a significant gap between current AI capabilities and real-world, complex human work environments.
The finding implies that current AI evaluation methods may not accurately reflect practical utility in professional settings.

stories.title: Linus Torvalds on AI-assisted kernel contributions
stories.author: lore.kernel.org via thang
bullet_points: Linus Torvalds discussed the use of AI assistance in contributing to the Linux kernel.
The topic touches upon the integration of AI tools into core software development practices.
This represents a moderate but significant discussion regarding the future of open-source development.

stories.title: Big Fish: Exploiting a 37-Year-Old Kernel Bug in OpenBSD
stories.author: calif.io via friday
bullet_points: A significant vulnerability was exploited in the OpenBSD kernel.
The bug is notable for its age, being present for 37 years.
The story highlights the ongoing security risks in established operating systems.

stories.title: Building Production-Ready Open-Weights AI Agents with Gemma, Google ADK, and Cloud Run GPUs
stories.author: robinamirbahar
bullet_points: Demonstrates building production-ready AI agents using open-weights models like Gemma.
Details the end-to-end MLOps lifecycle on Google Cloud, including scaling and governance.
Highlights practical application by fine-tuning an agent for enterprise SecOps and FinOps tasks using QLoRA.
